lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a semi-ordered grid. Density is highest in the region posterior to the gills and superior to the pectoral fin, with spots appearing larger and more widely spaced towards the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a visible matrix of anchor nodes along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp pixel intensity gradient with high-reflectance upper edges and shadowed lower margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance spots scattered across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, with higher contrast visible against the darker fin membrane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss and irregular indentation along the apex and posterior margin of the first dorsal fin, consistent with mechanical trauma or predation.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae (remoras) attached to the ventral and posterior margins of the pectoral fin and lower flank.
